gates.text: Own a bounded, checkable exit predicate and state it before the first iteration.
Respect existing authority, scope, holds, and owners; an autonomy grant does not erase operator gates.
Keep a real completion path.
Collect child results through their accepted native mode.

Unattended command continuation is BLOCKED for this skill-guided route: pstack arms requester-admitted scheduled turns only for its native controller workflows. Provide an explicit resume handoff instead of silently skipping it or creating a timer. Any supported implementation must follow the native [automation lifecycle](automation/README.md) with the existing non-main owner, event trigger, bounded fallback interval, deadline, and iteration budget.
If the required connector or scheduler is absent, report continuation BLOCKED and leave a concrete handoff.
Setup or dry-run never activates a job.
Never execute upstream loop or watcher helpers.
Make the smallest evidence-backed unit, verify it against the predicate before the next unit, then commit it if it advances the goal or discard it completely if it does not.
No speculative defensive changes remain.
Stage scoped files only, and never commit or publish without authority.
A missing commit checkpoint is BLOCKED rather than silently skipped.
Record every iteration and its predicate movement in the append-only [show-me-your-work](workflows.md#show-me-your-work) trail, including pivots, discards, and blockers.
Fix authorized reversible blockers and return to the predicate.
Keep out-of-band fixes separate and do not expand task scope; irreversible decisions and genuine product calls retain their gates.
A plateau alone is not done.
Pivot approach rather than relax the predicate.
Stop successfully only when the predicate is observed true.
A genuine dead end or expired bound gets an explicit incomplete handoff, not a lowered goal or a promise of unarranged background work.
Before handback, audit this run's trail against authorized scoped native history and resolving evidence pointers.
Resolve a different-family trail reviewer with `pstack_route`, spawn through native `sessions_spawn`, collect it, and include its Attention flags.
Self-review is not a substitute.
If independent review or family evidence is unavailable, the audit/review gate is BLOCKED, not complete.
**Reply.** Exit predicate, iterations, kept commits or delivered work, discarded work, final predicate state, trail path, and Attention section with reviewer model and specific flags or no flags.

When a bounded wait returns with an announcing child still pending, hand off under the [bounded-wait handoff](contract.md#bounded-wait-handoff) and end the turn: no history reads, test reruns, source probes or second waits while it is pending.
